THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
135
STUDY 129
Mint Crop & Patterned Trousers
Rights check
Source: 25011.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with light brown hair in two
low buns stands against a gray studio backdrop. She
wears a sheer pale mint long-sleeve crop top with a
lace-ribbon bodice and multi-strand chains with a heart
pendant. Patterned olive wide-leg trousers have a
knotted sash at the waist with purple flowers. She
carries an orange crossbody bag and wears white
canvas sneakers. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft, even studio light. Palette of mint, olive, and
orange. Playful and nostalgic, in the style of a 2000s
Y2K lookbook.
Playful, nostalgic, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The mint crop and patterned trousers are the signature
pairing.
- Keep the gray backdrop for a clean studio look.
